question: A 480 m long train takes 16 seconds to pass a pole. How long will it take to pass a platform that is 900 m long?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When speed is constant, Time is directly proportional to Distance.

Distance covered to cross a pole = 480 m

Distance covered to cross the platform = 480 + 900 = 1380 m

Ratio of distances = 480 : 1380 = 48 : 138 = 8 : 23

Time to cross platform = (16 ÷ 8) × 23 = 46 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 46 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the train = 480 m

Time taken to cross the pole = 16 seconds

Length of the platform = 900 m

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Time = Total Distance ÷ Speed
